03 · Connectome simulation

Perch

A pet fruit fly driven by a model of a real fly's brain.

Raise one fruit fly over 50 days. Every reaction replays a recorded trial of a spiking model run on the BANC connectome, the mapped brain and nerve cord of one real fly. Open any reaction to watch it travel through her brain in 3D.

169,078neurons
3,542recorded trials
3sister flies
23situations
Stack
JavaScript · three.js / WebGL · Python / Numba (model runs)
Model
Leaky integrate-and-fire network on BANC v888 wiring, 0.1 ms steps
Labels
Every claim tagged BRAIN, REPLAY or DESIGN
